utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, you mentioned the repair drive earlier—how's that coming along?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Mara, sorry I'm late to the chat. The repair drive's going okay—got a few folks signed up so far.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's good to hear—every little bit counts. Have we got enough volunteers yet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Is the repair drive happening now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me more about which repair drive you're referring to?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The one for the community center next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been organizing the supplies for the repair drive. Do we have enough paint and brushes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think there's some paint in the garage... maybe? I'd have to check.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let's go check the garage together, I want to make sure we have enough for the whole block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive? I haven't heard about it. What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, it's a community effort to fix up the old playground equipment. But I'm worried about the liability if someone gets hurt.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hmm, liability is tricky. Maybe we could get everyone to sign a waiver?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, what's going on with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure, I've only heard bits and pieces. What have you heard?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not much, just that they're asking for old electronics. You got anything to donate?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about it! I've got some spare tools I can bring along to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh that's wonderful, Gus! I heard they're also looking for folks to sign up for a potluck lunch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I'm spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I heard something about it. Where exactly is it being held?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM on Saturday. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, how's the repair drive going? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that drive is actually working? I've seen it sit untouched for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I could give it a test run if you'd like, make sure everything's in order.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How can we make it a success?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: How about we just put up a few flyers at the community center and call it good?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's a start! But maybe we can also go door-to-door to let folks know? I think personal invites really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, I heard there's a repair drive happening this weekend. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't decided yet. What time does it start? I like to have a schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm not sure of the exact time, but I can ask around and let you know. Want me to find out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Uli, sorry to ask, but could you remind me what the repair drive is for again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's to raise money for fixing the community center roof.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah right, the roof! Thanks for reminding me. I'll be sure to chip in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I heard you're helping with the repair drive — that's awesome! How's it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it's going pretty well! Folks have been bringing in all sorts of things to fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad to hear it! I've got a few neighbors who might want to join in — I'll pass the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! I heard about the repair drive—count me in to help spread the word around the neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, thanks for jumping in! I'll probably be late to the first meeting, but I'm in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem, Dane! I'll make sure to update you on anything important from the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Haven't seen you around much, Eli. How's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's coming along nicely. I've been making a list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What sort of things are on your list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, I was thinking about the repair drive this weekend. Do you have a moment to discuss the drop-off times?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I’d love to help. How about we set up a morning drop-off from 9 to noon?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Mara. I'll make sure to be there from 9 to noon to help receive donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, are you heading to the repair drive this weekend? I think we can get a good group together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I'm planning to go! I heard it's going to be a big event, lots of folks from the neighborhood are coming.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! I was thinking we could invite some of the people from the gardening club too—they might have tools to share.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a truck full of tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's generous, Gus—do you have any spare parts for older models, or is it mostly hand tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got both, actually. Bunch of spare parts from old lawnmowers and bikes, plus all the usual wrenches and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I checked the repair drive schedule; it's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks for confirming! I'll make sure to bring my old toaster and some extra tools—do we have enough volunteers signed up yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, we have about ten so far, but the sign-up sheet is still out at the library if anyone else wants to join.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you going to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What kind of repairs are they doing? I need to know if I should bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: They fix small appliances, so bring your toaster.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need a hand with the repair drive, Cleo? I've got some tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam! I'll keep you posted on what we might need. Always good to have spare tools on hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Cleo. Just holler if you need anything—I'm around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, I've heard some chatter about a repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that... maybe at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the community center? I haven't been there yet. Do you know when it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, honey, don't you worry! I heard it's organized by Mrs. Gable's church group, and they're super trustworthy. They fixed old man Jenkins' roof last month!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I guess Mrs. Gable does run a tight ship. But you're sure it's not some kind of scam?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, how's the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's going, slowly. I've been a bit preoccupied lately.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, sorry to hear that. Everything okay?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but I can't quite remember. Can you remind me what it's for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's to collect used electronics for fixing and donating.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right! I think I have an old laptop somewhere. I'll see if I can find it.
